hero.title: Stablecoins in and out of Bitcoin Cash.
hero.sub.none: Each flow opens here once it has been measured on mainnet. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap: Swap BCH and PUSD through Cauldron pools, signed in your own wallet. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.land: Send BCH from any wallet to your landing address and it arrives as PUSD, or comes back to you. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.cross: Bring {symbols} in as PUSD in your BCH wallet, and send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-land: Swap BCH and PUSD through Cauldron pools, signed in your own wallet. Or send BCH from any wallet to your landing address and it arrives as PUSD. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-cross: Swap BCH and PUSD on Bitcoin Cash, bring {symbols} in as PUSD, and send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.land-cross: Bring in BCH from any wallet, or {symbols} from another chain, as PUSD in your BCH wallet. Send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-land-cross: Swap BCH and PUSD, land BCH as PUSD, and move {symbols} in and out as PUSD. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.honest: On Bitcoin Cash every step is a transaction you sign, or a contract that can only pay you. The crossing between chains is carried by {route}.

alerts.synthetic.page: Sampan synthetic check: the front page or one of its scripts or styles did not load twice in a row ({detail}). Judges would see a broken or blank page. Check the container and the proxy; follow docs/OPERATIONS.md, Alerts and actions.
alerts.synthetic.config: Sampan synthetic check: /api/config did not answer with valid data twice in a row ({detail}). The page cannot start without it. Restart the container with the same tag; see docs/OPERATIONS.md.
alerts.synthetic.health: Sampan synthetic check: the site reports a provider down twice in a row ({detail}). The page shows the status line and pauses the flow that needs it. If an outside provider is down, wait for it; no code fix during judging week.
alerts.synthetic.quote: Sampan synthetic check: a swap quote for 0.001 BCH failed twice in a row ({detail}). Judges cannot swap. Check the indexer and Electrum lines of the same run; see docs/OPERATIONS.md.
alerts.synthetic.landing: Sampan synthetic check: opening a landing address for the test wallet failed twice in a row ({detail}). Judges cannot try Bring in. See docs/OPERATIONS.md, Alerts and actions.
alerts.synthetic.indexer: Sampan synthetic check: no Cauldron indexer returned a pool twice in a row ({detail}). An outside provider is down; the page shows the status and swaps pause. No code fix during judging week: wait for the provider.
alerts.synthetic.electrum: Sampan synthetic check: no Bitcoin Cash server answered twice in a row ({detail}). An outside provider is down; the page shows the status. No code fix during judging week: wait for the providers.
alerts.synthetic.thornode: Sampan synthetic check: no THORChain node reports BCH and a live chain open twice in a row ({detail}). Crossings are paused and the page says so. An outside provider; no code fix during judging week.
alerts.synthetic.render: Sampan synthetic check: the front page test in Chromium and iPhone WebKit failed twice in a row ({detail}). Judges on a phone may see a broken page. Restart the container with the same tag, then check again.

how.title: How Sampan works
how.lead: Every step is a Bitcoin Cash transaction you can look up in an explorer. The Sampan server holds no key and never signs for you.
how.land.title: Landing address
how.land.text: You get the address of a small contract. BCH that reaches it can leave in only two ways, both to your address: converted to {symbol} in Cauldron pools at no less than the minimum rate fixed in the address, or, once the coin is {blocks} blocks old, given back as BCH.
how.swap.title: Swap on BCH
how.swap.text: Your wallet signs one transaction that trades with Cauldron pools. Before your wallet sees it, the page checks every output: each one pays you or goes back to a pool it rebuilt, and nothing else is allowed.
how.cross.title: Between chains
how.cross.text: {route} carries the value between Bitcoin Cash and {symbols} on {chains}. Going out, your {symbol} is swapped to BCH in Cauldron pools and handed to {route}. Coming in, the BCH that arrives goes to a landing address of the same contract.
how.source.title: The landing contract
how.source.text: This is the whole contract, as compiled into every landing address. No key of the service appears in it.
how.source.link: Open the file in the repository
how.verify.title: Verify a landing address yourself
how.verify.text: Download the recovery card from the status page of your landing. Then, in a copy of the source code, run:
how.verify.after: It compiles the contract from source and checks that it gives the same address as the card.
how.finish.title: Anyone can run the finisher
how.finish.text: The contract checks where the coins go, not who sends the transaction. The Sampan server finishes landings by itself. If it stops, this script does the same from any computer, using public Electrum servers and the public Cauldron indexer:
how.finish.optional: For a landing, Sampan's server is optional. Swaps and crossings still need it, for the quote and to build the transaction.
how.finish.after: Add --dry-run to build and check the transaction without sending it, or --help to list the options.
how.exists.title: What already exists and what this adds
how.exists.checked: Checked on 16 November 2026, and BCH Bull on 17 November 2026.
how.exists.cauldron: The Cauldron app has an X-chain tab that swaps plain BCH with other chains through THORChain. Its code does not send CashTokens to the cross-chain vault.
how.exists.paytaca: Paytaca has Cash In, which gets you BCH by converting other coins through SideShift or by buying from peers.
how.exists.gap: In both, getting to {symbol} is a second swap.
how.exists.bchbull: BCH Bull's own site describes hedging BCH against USD and other assets, or going long or short on BCH, with AnyHedge contracts funded in BCH, while Sampan trades BCH for {symbol}, a token you then hold.

legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.lead: Plain words on what Sampan is, who runs it and what you accept when you use it.
legal.risks.title: Risks
legal.risks.lead: What can go wrong, and what happens to your funds in each case.
terms.experiment.title: Experimental software
terms.experiment.text: Sampan is experimental software made for a hackathon. It is provided as is. Use amounts you can afford to lose.
terms.operator.title: Who runs this site
terms.role.title: What Sampan is not
terms.role.text: Sampan is not an exchange, a broker, a custodian or an adviser. It never holds your funds or your keys. Every transaction is built for your wallet to show you, and your wallet signs it. A landing address is a contract on Bitcoin Cash, not an account with us.
terms.parties.title: Who does the work
terms.parties.text: Swaps between BCH and {symbol} are made against Cauldron liquidity pools, contracts on Bitcoin Cash funded by their own liquidity providers. Transactions travel through public Bitcoin Cash servers. Sampan runs neither.
terms.route.title: Crossings to other chains
terms.route.text: Crossings between Bitcoin Cash and other chains are carried out by {route}, software and operators independent of Sampan. Sampan prepares the transaction you sign; {route} decides whether and when the crossing completes. The funds pass through {route} vaults on the chain you choose.
terms.warranty.title: No warranty
terms.warranty.text: The site, its contracts and the services it uses, including Cauldron pools, Bitcoin Cash servers and any cross-chain route, are provided without warranty of any kind. As far as the law where you are allows, neither the operator nor those providers are liable for any loss that comes from using Sampan.
terms.final.title: Transactions are final
terms.final.text: Once a transaction is confirmed, nobody can reverse it: not you, not the operator and not the pools.
terms.costs.title: Fees and price
terms.costs.text: Each transaction pays a network fee, and pools take their own fee. Prices move between a quote and its confirmation. Before you sign, the page shows the least you will receive.
terms.wallet.title: Your wallet and your addresses
terms.wallet.text: You are responsible for your wallet, its recovery phrase and every address you enter. Coins sent to a wrong address cannot be recovered.
terms.restricted.title: Where Sampan is not offered
terms.restricted.text: Sampan is not offered to people, countries or regions under sanctions. You are responsible for following the laws that apply where you are.
terms.data.title: Your data
terms.data.text: There are no accounts. The server keeps public addresses and the details of each landing and crossing (amounts, transaction ids and status) so the page can show their history. It keeps no names, emails or keys. The site loads no analytics or tracking scripts; your language choice is kept in your browser.
terms.oneclick.title: Crossings through NEAR Intents
terms.oneclick.text: When you pick NEAR Intents under "Choose a route", the crossing is carried out by the 1Click service of Intents Technology, which is independent of Sampan. Sampan prepares the deposit you sign; Intents Technology and the parties it works with decide whether and when the crossing completes. For crossings on this route:

terms.oneclick.list.warranty: Intents Technology gives no warranty of any kind, express, implied or statutory.
terms.oneclick.list.final: Transactions are irreversible and are subject to network fees, slippage, bridging and cross-chain transfer risks, and other on-chain risks.

risks.price.title: The price moves
risks.price.text: Pool prices change with every trade, and a landing address fixes a minimum rate when it is made.
risks.price.funds: A swap that no longer matches the pool is rejected and your coins stay in your wallet. BCH at a landing address that cannot be converted at the minimum rate waits there; once the coin is {blocks} blocks old it is given back to your address as BCH, less a small network fee. A payment of less than about {dust} sat is too small to give back after the fee and stays in the contract.
risks.route.title: The cross-chain route fails
risks.route.text: {route} can pause, run short of liquidity or refuse a crossing whose price moved past its limit. If {route} halts the chain you chose during a crossing, the payment out can be delayed until that chain resumes.
risks.route.funds: {route} sends the coins back to the address they came from, less its fees. Sampan cannot speed up or redirect a refund.
risks.address.title: A wrong address
risks.address.text: The page checks that an address is well formed and on the right network, but it cannot know whether the address is yours.
risks.address.funds: Coins sent to a wrong address cannot be recovered by anyone.
risks.network.title: The wrong network
risks.network.text: A landing address works on Bitcoin Cash. Bitcoin and Bitcoin SV addresses can look alike.
risks.network.funds: Coins sent from another network never reach the contract. Sampan cannot see or return them.
risks.server.title: Our server stops
risks.server.text: The Sampan server watches landing addresses and finishes them, and it can go down. Swaps simply stop while it is down; nothing is held in between.
risks.server.funds: Coins at a landing address stay in the contract, which pays to your address and nowhere else. With the recovery card from the status page, anyone can finish the landing or give the coins back using the script in the source code. How it works shows the steps.
risks.approval.title: Token approvals on EVM chains
risks.approval.text: Bringing in a token from an EVM chain can need an approval that lets a contract move that token from your wallet.
risks.approval.funds: Sampan asks for the exact amount of each crossing, never an unlimited approval. To cancel an approval, approve zero for the same contract in your wallet or in a block explorer's approval checker.
risks.oneclick.title: The NEAR Intents route fails or holds a crossing
risks.oneclick.text: 1Click can refuse a quote, pause, or fail to fill a deposit before its deadline. Its compliance controls can delay or block a crossing. Tokens can travel through a bridge, which adds that bridge's risks.
risks.oneclick.funds: A deposit that is not filled is sent back to the refund address in the quote, which is always your own address, less fees. A crossing held by a compliance control can stay unavailable for a period or indefinitely. Sampan cannot speed up, redirect or release it.
health.label: Service status
paused.route.title: Paused by the route
paused.route.body: {route} reports that Bitcoin Cash or the other chain is halted, so nothing new is sent this way. This tab opens again by itself when {route} reopens.
boot.text: Loading the page. If this line stays, reload the page.
error.title: This part of the page stopped working.
error.body: A fault in the page stopped it from drawing. Reload to try again. If you had started a payment, check your wallet before paying again.
error.server: The Sampan server is not answering, so prices and tabs cannot load. Try again in a minute.
error.provider: Not answering right now: {names}. Steps that need it cannot finish until it is back; the status line at the foot of the page shows when it is.
error.page.failedBody: The server could not build this page. Try again in a minute.
error.page.notFoundBody: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.
error.page.home: Go to the Sampan front page
how.pay.text: Shops can use the same landing contract: with Sampan Pay each invoice is a landing address whose owner is the shop.
pay.shop.title: Sampan Pay
pay.shop.lead: Take BCH at a price in US dollars and receive {symbol}. Each invoice gets its own landing address, and the BCH that reaches it is converted to {symbol} for the shop by the same contract as every Sampan landing.
pay.shop.limits: Invoices from {min} to {max} USD, open for {minutes} minutes. No account and no key: Sampan holds no key to the money.
pay.shop.productNote: Nothing is shipped. The order turns to fulfilled once the demo shop's server has checked the signed webhook.
pay.shop.demoNote: The demo shop is paid to the project's test wallet. You pay about {price} USD of BCH from your own wallet, and it is not refunded.
pay.shop.err: The invoice could not be made. Try again in a moment.
pay.shop.api.create: Make an invoice from your server with the amount in USD and your token address (it starts with z). The answer has the address, the amount in BCH, a QR code and a status page for the customer.
pay.shop.api.status: Read the status at any time: open, paid, underpaid, overpaid, expired or paid_late.
pay.shop.api.webhook: Optional webhook: Sampan posts a signed message (Standard Webhooks) after it has read the convert transaction back from the network.
pay.shop.api.button: Or add the button script to your page. It opens the status page in a new tab.
pay.shop.example: See the button on an example page
pay.inv.title: Pay {usd} USD in BCH
pay.inv.lead: The shop receives {symbol}. Send the amount below to this address from any BCH wallet.
pay.inv.detected: Payment seen. Watch the ferry carry it across to the shop.
pay.inv.qrLabel: QR code: pay {amount} BCH to this invoice
pay.inv.status.converting: Payment seen. Converting it to {symbol} for the shop.
pay.inv.status.underpaid: Part paid: {paid} of {required} BCH. Send the rest, {rest} BCH, to the same address before the time runs out. What was paid goes to the shop, not back to you.
pay.inv.status.underpaidLate: Part paid: {paid} of {required} BCH, and the time is up. What was paid went to the shop; ask the shop to finish or refund the order.
pay.inv.status.overpaid: Paid more than asked: {paid} of {required} BCH. All of it went to the shop; ask the shop about the difference.
pay.inv.status.expired: This invoice expired with no payment. Do not pay this address now; ask the shop for a new invoice.
pay.inv.status.paid_late: Paid after the time ran out. The BCH still went to the shop; ask the shop to confirm your order.
pay.inv.order.waiting: Demo shop: waiting for the signed webhook.
pay.inv.order.fulfilled: Demo shop: order fulfilled. The shop's server checked the signed webhook.
pay.inv.missing: There is no invoice at this link.
pay.inv.error: The invoice could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
cost.title: Before you sign
cost.leftover: About {usd} stays in your own wallet as BCH.
cost.impactHigh: The price impact is above {pct}%. A smaller amount moves the price less.
cost.costHigh: The cost is above {pct}% of what you pay. A larger amount costs less in percent.
cost.expired: This price has run out. Change the amount to get a new one.
cost.details: What the cost is made of
cost.basis: {token} and {symbol} count as USD 1 each. BCH is valued at the price in this {route} quote.
cost.part.impact: Cauldron price impact and price gap
cost.part.convertNetwork: Network fee to change BCH to {token} at the landing address
receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.minutes: About {n} min, from preparing the transaction until Sampan saw the payout
receipt.basis: {symbol} counts as USD 1. BCH is valued at the price in the quote this crossing was built from.
